verdict.rationale: Otter's docs say summaries automatically include action items (otter-docs-21) and that next steps are 'automatically captured and assigned from every meeting' (otter-docs-3), with deadlines (otter-docs-30). Those action items can be pushed into trackers such as JIRA, Asana and ClickUp (otter-docs-10, otter-docs-31) and searched in Glean (otter-docs-33). Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how owners are identified and assigned (only a one-line 'assigned' claim), and any independent or hands-on corroboration of action-item extraction accuracy.
